units.source_text: 尽管如此，这个“希望”陷阱究竟有什么地方不合乌鸦们的胃口呢？

en.t: Even so, what exactly was it about this trap called "Hope" that did not suit the crows' taste?

units.source_text: 不管你从哪里，怎么看，似乎都没有一点儿怪异之处。

en.t: No matter where you looked from, or how you looked at it, there seemed to be nothing strange about it at all.

units.source_text: 那些乌鸦们，专门寻找人类的废弃物，只在人们的周围打转转，总之，它们的小心谨慎是出类拔萃的。

en.t: Those crows specialized in searching out human refuse and only circled around where people were; in short, their caution was outstanding.

units.source_text: 这样的话，只能比比谁的耐性好了。

en.t: In that case, all that remained was to see whose patience would hold out longer.

units.source_text: 等到这个坑里边的烂鱼对于那些乌鸦们的意识来说，变成完全的反复……

en.t: Until the rotten fish inside this pit became, in the crows' minds, a complete repetition...

units.source_text: “忍耐”这玩意儿，其实并不是失败……

en.t: This thing called "patience" is not actually failure...

units.source_text: 倒不如说，当感到“忍耐”是失败的时候，那才算是真正失败的开端吧。

en.t: Rather, the moment one feels that "patience" is failure is probably the true beginning of failure.

units.source_text: 原来给陷阱取名“希望”，也就是基于这样的打算。

en.t: So naming the trap "Hope" had been based on that very calculation.

units.source_text: “希望峰”在直布罗陀……不对，好像在开普敦……

en.t: The "Cape of Hope" is in Gibraltar... no, that is not right, it seems to be in Cape Town...
